200.description: The newest frame of the run (live screencast or last screenshot).

get.description: The run's plan, for the live pipeline view. 404 until the agent has written it.
Session state plus CSRF cookie issuance. The frontend calls this on application start.

**Liveness.** Answers "the process is alive" and deliberately touches neither the
database nor Redis.

If it did, a brief database outage would end in pods restarting in a loop — a dependency
outage turned into an application outage.

Exempt from rate limiting (`RATE_LIMIT_EXEMPT_PATHS`): orchestrators hit this often, and a
throttled probe looks like an outage to them.

**Readiness.** Answers "I can serve a request", so it checks dependencies.

503 takes the instance out of the load balancer without killing it — exactly what we want
when the database dies: pods wait instead of restarting over and over.

put.description:
Sets the caller's own details; fields left out stay as they are. The document number
is write-only: the response carries it masked.

post.description: Idempotent: a member opening the invite link again just gets the trip back.

A trip from one sentence. Complete -> the trip is created (caller = organizer) and the
package research starts (`trip` set, `questions` empty). Otherwise `trip` is null and
`questions` say what to ask; send the text again with the answers.

get.description: The whole room in one response — the UI polls this one endpoint.

Ranked attraction candidates at the destination with their voters (after the package
vote; the list is fixed at the first request).

post.description: Toggles the caller's vote on one attraction; answers with the updated list.

get.description:
The trip's recent supplier API calls (Duffel, LiteAPI), oldest first: method, path
without ids, status, duration. Members only; poll it for the mission-control terminal.

post.description: Approves every summary awaiting approval at once — refused unless every share is paid.

Asks the suppliers that report disruptions about the trip's bought bookings; every
notice with a replacement is rebooked and re-split. Empty = nothing happened.
"Book everything": starts every startable booking; refusals are reported per booking.
After a handoff (or a failure) the organizer finished the purchase by hand.
Charges the caller's outstanding share; the last payment moves the trip to booking.

The organizer pays for everyone (organizer only): tops the organizer's wallet up by the total
shortfall (BLIK / card) and pays every outstanding share from it; each is recorded as paid
by the organizer. Pays right away when the wallet already covers the total.

Tops the wallet up by exactly the shortfall (BLIK / card) and pays the share once the
bank confirms; pays right away when the wallet already covers it.

delete.description: Stops the run; whatever it already did to the trip stays done.

get.description: The live progress of the trip's latest run (404 when none ran since the start-up).

post.description: Starts a choreography (409 while one is already playing on the trip).
The demo's last scene: the transport is delayed, the agent rebooks and re-splits.
A seeded member drops out — the organizer drives it from the demo panel.

get.description: One compact card per member for the six-phone grid.
The day-by-day plan (no days until the organizer plans them).

post.description:
The organizer plans (or re-plans) the days from the votes; bookable visits queue their
tickets, which re-splits the shares.
The caller drops out before anything is bought; the rest re-split the total.
The organizer moves the funding deadline (PAYING only, must be in the future).
Starts the research and returns at once; the packages arrive in the feed.

get.description: The caller's balance and their newest 50 ledger entries.

post.description: Simulated ID verification at the payment partner: pending now, verified in ~1 s.
Starts a dummy BLIK / card top-up: pending now, completed (or declined) in ~1.5 s.

get.description: Polled by the top-up sheet until the status leaves `pending`.
